# Variable `UBOOT_MKIMAGE_KERNEL_TYPE`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies the type argument for the kernel as passed to `uboot-mkimage`. The default value is “kernel”.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-UBOOT_MKIMAGE_KERNEL_TYPE
